values.note: Park's own 2026 and 2027 rate sheets (identical). On-season (April-October) Sun-Thu / Fri-Sat / holiday weekends: basic $12 / $15 / $17, electric 30A $21 / $27 / $29, electric 50A $23 / $29 / $31, family basic $20 / $22 / $22, family electric 30A $36 / $42 / $44, family electric 50A $40 / $46 / $48. Off-season (November-March) Sun-Thu / Fri-Sat: basic $12 / $13, electric 30A $19 / $23, electric 50A $21 / $25, family basic $20, family electric $34-38 / $36-40. Rates include sales tax; $6.50 online reservation fee per site.

note: Six wooded ridge-top loops on a Truman Lake peninsula, near the park marina; boat and ATV trailers may park on the grass beside the pad. Devil's Backbone is carry-in, carry-out December-February. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $12-17 basic base, electric +12, 2026/2027 identical; added 181 sites (pads to 71 ft), 50A electric, facilities, military $2 discount, reservation season Apr 1-Oct 31; PIN 1.7 km off; lakefront -> lakeview recommended.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakefront not supported -> lakeview (downgrade, not a question). Checked every loop against the UseDirect site points: all six loops run along wooded ridge tops; the closest pads to Truman Lake are at the loop tips - Thorny Ridge F181/F183/185/186 ~60-80 m from the shoreline, Wild Turkey Ridge F131 ~70 m, Thorny Ridge 157/158 ~90 m beside the boat-ramp lot - all behind woods (or the ramp lot), so no pad is on the water. A view is supported at those tips (the ramp-side sites look across the open lot to the lake; the others through thin woods), so lakeview rather than not waterfront.

PIN: stored 38.2716,-93.4468 is ~1.0-2.5 km south of every loop (1.7 km from the sites' centre). Move to 38.2864,-93.4537 (centre of all 181 sites; Buck Ridge, the largest loop, centres at 38.2861,-93.4505).

SEASON (manual, not touched): matches the page and the 2027 sheet ('Raccoon Ridge, Bobcat Run, and Thorny Ridge campgrounds are closed Nov. through Feb.; Buck Ridge and Wild Turkey Ridge campgrounds are closed Nov. through March'; Devil's Backbone year-round).
HOOKUPS: no water or sewer at the sites on the grid or page; only electric written (water/sewer left absent).
